confidence_notes: Dali-specific crowd-sourced prices support the meal, coffee, and pub-beer estimates. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass prices are less certain and are estimated from their local price relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are broad estimates for a well-visited Yunnan tourist town, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and drink estimates use Dali-specific price data; accommodation estimates reflect Dali's role as a lakeside and heritage tourism destination in Yunnan. No comparable city was used.
